conventions.convention: SI units; Schwarzschild mass M > 0 is fixed, k = c³/(4GM) has units s⁻¹, θ = 2π/k has units seconds, and angular frequency ω > 0 has units s⁻¹.
Hilbert inner products and number forms are conjugate-linear in the first entry. Packet annihilation maps are conjugate-linear; B_s(f,g) = varpi(a_s(g)*a_s(f)) uses reversed labels.

Packets lie in L² of compact positive-frequency bands. Translation is τ_s f(ω) = exp(iωs)f(ω), giving p_(τ_s f)(u) = p_f(u−s). Continuum frequency symbols denote smeared distributions, not pointwise operators.
Fixed-band convergence is in operator norm. With the stipulated exact translations, this forces B_s = B_∞ for every s; it supplies no four-dimensional scattering estimate.
The narrow-band limit uses weak convergence of normalized spectral probability measures to a point mass, after the late-time limit. It is not L² convergence to a monochromatic vector.
Hadamard covectors are future-null metric-dual tangents with a common positive scale; their base points may occur in either parameter order.
T_∞ labels the unfiltered Bose exponent and is not an observed temperature; transmission filtering need not preserve Planck form.

load_bearing.statement: For each fixed compact positive-frequency band K, the supplied bounded outgoing number forms converge in operator norm to B_(ℓ,∞)(f,g) = ∫_K conjugate(f(ω))g(ω)Γ_ℓ(ω)n_θ(ω)dω. The state, channel identification, transmission and convergence are adopted premises; four-dimensional scattering and empirical temperature are not derived.

Under all conditions of the preceding collapse postulate, a normalized smooth packet has limiting occupation ∫_K |f(ω)|²Γ_ℓ(ω)/(exp(2πω/k)−1)dω. For normalized packets supported in K whose spectral measures converge weakly to δ_(ω₀), the ordered late-time then narrow-band limit is Γ_ℓ(ω₀)/(exp(2πω₀/k)−1). Matching the unfiltered Bose exponent defines T_∞ = ℏc³/(8πGMk_B), not an observed temperature.

The remark explicitly defines the right exterior by X > |T| and the black-hole interior by T > |X|, then describes the Unruh state's domain as the right exterior together with that interior.
